name: kanduu-digital-workplace
description: M365 extensibility for kanduu digital workplace.

scripts.build: npm run shared:build && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.customizers-global:build: npm run shared:build && npm run build -w customizers-global
scripts.customizers-global:start: npm run shared:build && npm run start -w customizers-global
scripts.webparts-global:build: npm run shared:build && npm run build -w webparts-global
scripts.webparts-global:start: npm run shared:build && npm run start -w webparts-global
scripts.stock-quote:start: npm run build -w @kanduu/worker-stock-quote && npm run start -w @kanduu/worker-stock-quote
scripts.stock-quote:once: npm run build -w @kanduu/worker-stock-quote && npm run once -w @kanduu/worker-stock-quote
